title: MAP = Likelihood × Prior
tagline: Watch regularization appear as a prior multiplying the likelihood in parameter space
summary: A 2-parameter model, drawn in parameter space. Overlay three contour sets — the likelihood (data fit), the prior (centered at zero), and their product the posterior — and mark the MLE, the MAP, and the origin. Tighten a Gaussian prior and see L2 shrinkage pull the MAP toward zero; switch to a Laplace prior and see L1 drive a coordinate to exactly zero; add more data and watch the MAP march back to the MLE. Regularization is just a prior.
highlights: See the posterior is literally the likelihood contours times the prior contours, drawn in 2-D parameter space.
The MAP estimate sits at the peak of the posterior — between the MLE (data) and the origin (prior).
Narrow a Gaussian prior and watch L2 regularization shrink both parameters smoothly toward zero.
Switch to a Laplace prior and watch its diamond contours snap a parameter to exactly zero — that is L1 sparsity.
Add data or lower the noise and the likelihood tightens, dragging the MAP back onto the MLE — the prior fades away.
